tool_config.name: amend_request
tool_config.description: Change one of the Foreman's own Requests that find_open_requests returned, after the Foreman confirmed the change. The backend decides whether it is applied: before the Owner is working on it, it is changed and {"applied": true, ...} returns what to read back; once it is In Progress or Resolved nothing is changed, the office is flagged, and it returns {"applied": false, "status": ...}. Returns {"error": "..."} if the change could not be saved.

request_body_schema.description: The Request and only the details the Foreman changes.

ref.description: The ref of the Request as find_open_requests returned it, for example R-1042.

changes.description: Only the details the Foreman changes; leave out everything else.

need.description: What is now needed, in the Foreman's words.

unit.description: The unit of the new quantity, for example trucks or tons.

needed_by_spoken.description: When it is now needed, in the Foreman's own words, for example "Thursday at seven". The same words you last gave resolve_needed_by.
